Destruction physics (a block demo on Patch)

Physics: three-avbd by Steven Bobyn (MIT), commit cd3ce90 (0.4.0 release candidate).
  https://github.com/sbobyn/three-avbd. Licence: LICENSE-three-avbd.txt; its third-party notices: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
  (ports of Chris Giles' avbd-demo2d and avbd-demo3d, MIT; box2d-lite by Erin Catto, MIT; three.js, MIT).
  The method is Augmented Vertex Block Descent (Giles, Diaz and Yuksel, SIGGRAPH 2025).
Sky and particles: from three-voxel-destruction by Steven Bobyn (MIT), by way of Patch's Brickfall and Timberfall.
  https://github.com/sbobyn/three-voxel-destruction. Licence: in LICENSE.txt.
three.js: MIT, the three.js authors. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
Textures (textures/*_diff|nor|arm.webp): Poly Haven, CC0: rough_wood, fine_grained_wood, clay_roof_tiles_02, rock_surface,
  rough_concrete, rusty_metal_sheet, leafy_grass, gravel_floor, bark_brown_02.
Sky light (hdri/): Qwantani late afternoon (puresky, 1k), Poly Haven, CC0.
Leaf and grass cards (textures/leaf_cluster.webp, grass_tuft.webp): composed from ambientCG's LeafSet004, Foliage001 and
  Foliage006, CC0.
Red Hat Mono (assets/red-hat-mono-*.woff2): The Red Hat Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1: OFL-red-hat-mono.txt.
The structures, the cannon, the demo and its sound code: Patch, MIT, after Patch's game Timberfall.
The Structure choice's pictures (thumbs/): stills of this demo, Patch, CC0.

Sounds (public/audio, audio/ in the demo): each recording below was cut, trimmed, made mono, filtered and levelled by Patch
into the layers named. The sound design follows Timberfall's.
